VINIT.justification: Initial void state: five BTC addresses enter as uninitialized input before base58check extraction.

TANCH.justification: Terminal anchor: EVALT gate and IFIX sealing form closed boundary within secp256k1 group order Q.

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism: walk steps advance tortoise and hare via x_{i+1}=x_i + R_{h(x_i)} recording affine coefficients.

AREV.justification: Contravariant descent: on collision computes n = (a_h - a_t) * inv(b_t - b_h, q) mod q.

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition: group law composes point additions as partition-class walk steps.

IMSCRIB.justification: Identity/self-reference: BTC address self-identifies within base58check encoding. IMASM word closes T.

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication delta: splits BTC address into version byte, hash160 digest, and checksum via base58check decode.

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication mu: rejoins version, hash160, checksum into exact BTC address via base58check encode.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation: verifies candidate scalar n where n*G == pk machine-verified this run.

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation: identifies collision failures and walk exhaustion over 2^256-order group.

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice: holds both toy-curve scalar recovery and secp256k1 generic DLOG bound simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: ROM fixation: permanent record of retrieval attempts in registry.json.
